name: SurvivalMysteryBoxPool - Default (seed v1)
description: A Mystery Box pool of a survival scenario (DESIGN §8a, S59): items or enchanted books, each entry with a percentage chance adding up to exactly 100 %.

steps.description: Name the pool and pick its variant. Both variants play through the same box; a Mystery Box point names one pool.

fields.label: Scenario
fields.description: The siege scenario this belongs to; filled in from the scenario you are editing.

fields.label: Variant
fields.description: Items: item blueprints with optional enchantment chances. EnchantedBooks: an enchantment and level per entry.

steps.description: The pool's entries and chances. Available once the pool is saved; readiness checks that they add up to 100 %.

fields.label: Entries
fields.description: Create New opens the entry form with this pool filled in.
